name: foodblock-node
description: A FoodBlock node: Postgres for the blocks, HTTP for signed pull, push and .well-known/foodblock
author: FoodX <developers@foodx.com>

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "const p=require('./package.json');const bad=Object.entries({...p.dependencies,...p.optionalDependencies}).filter(([,v])=>/^(file|link|git|https?):/.test(v));if(bad.length){console.error('refusing to publish with local dependencies: '+bad.map(([k,v])=>k+'@'+v).join(', '));process.exit(1)}"
